<!-- APPLICATION FORM -->
<section id="apply" class="py-16 md:py-24 border-t border-line scroll-mt-4">
  <div class="max-w-2xl mx-auto px-5">
    <h2 class="font-display font-extrabold text-3xl md:text-4xl">Apply for a Media Buying Strategy Session</h2>
    <p class="mt-3 text-neutral-400">Takes about two minutes. If your brand is a fit, I'll reach out on WhatsApp to book your session.</p>

    <div class="mt-8 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-6 md:p-8">
      <form id="applyForm" novalidate class="space-y-5">
        <div class="hidden" aria-hidden="true"><label>Leave empty <input type="text" name="website_hp" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off"></label></div>

        <div>
          <label for="name" class="block text-sm font-medium mb-1.5">Full Name</label>
          <input class="field" id="name" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Your full name" required>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label for="email" class="block text-sm font-medium mb-1.5">Email Address</label>
          <input class="field" id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@brand.com" required>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label for="whatsapp" class="block text-sm font-medium mb-1.5">WhatsApp Number with Country Code</label>
          <input class="field" id="whatsapp" name="whatsapp" type="tel" autocomplete="tel" inputmode="tel" placeholder="+20 100 000 0000" required>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label for="brand" class="block text-sm font-medium mb-1.5">Brand Name / Website URL</label>
          <input class="field" id="brand" name="website" type="url" placeholder="https://yourbrand.com" required>
        </div>
        <div class="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
          <div>
            <label for="budget" class="block text-sm font-medium mb-1.5">Monthly Ad Budget</label>
            <select class="field" id="budget" name="budget" required>
              <option value="" disabled selected>Select budget</option>
              <option>&lt; $1,000</option>
              <option>$1,000 - $3,000</option>
              <option>$3,000 - $10,000</option>
              <option>$10,000+</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label for="goal" class="block text-sm font-medium mb-1.5">Primary Goal</label>
            <select class="field" id="goal" name="goal" required>
              <option value="" disabled selected>Select goal</option>
              <option>Increase Sales/E-commerce Revenue</option>
              <option>Generate B2B Leads</option>
              <option>Brand Awareness</option>
              <option>Other</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label for="about" class="block text-sm font-medium mb-1.5">Tell me briefly about your business &amp; current ad strategy <span class="text-neutral-500 font-normal">(optional)</span></label>
          <textarea class="field" id="about" name="notes" rows="4" placeholder="What you sell, where you advertise now, and what's not working"></textarea>
        </div>

        <p id="formError" class="hidden text-sm text-bloodhi" role="alert"></p>
        <button id="submitBtn" type="submit" class="btn-cta w-full rounded-xl px-6 py-4 font-bold text-white text-lg">Submit Application</button>
      </form>

      <div id="successBox" class="hidden text-center py-8" role="status" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="mx-auto w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-blood/15 border border-blood flex items-center justify-center">
          <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#f0263a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12l5 5 9-10"/></svg>
        </div>
        <h3 class="mt-5 font-display font-extrabold text-2xl">Application received</h3>
        <p class="mt-2 text-neutral-400">Thanks, <span id="successName"></span>. I review every application personally and will message you on WhatsApp within 24 hours.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
  // ---- CONFIG ----
  // Paste a Formspree / Make / Zapier / Google Apps Script webhook URL to receive applications.
  // Leave empty to simulate success (useful for testing).
  const FORM_ENDPOINT = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzpUE8jkGevkIcLrYygnP_E8Hu2DtWLvM5OiPu6F4erss5sTf-rbeqlemwSiKnza-KXwg/exec";

  document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

  const form = document.getElementById('applyForm');
  const errorEl = document.getElementById('formError');
  const btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  const successBox = document.getElementById('successBox');

  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
    if (form.website_hp.value) return; // bot trap

    // Auto-fix URL without protocol
    const brand = form.brand;
    if (brand.value && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(brand.value.trim())) brand.value = 'https://' + brand.value.trim();

    let firstBad = null;
    form.querySelectorAll('[required]').forEach((el) => {
      const bad = !el.value.trim() || !el.checkValidity();
      el.classList.toggle('invalid', bad);
      if (bad && !firstBad) firstBad = el;
    });
    if (firstBad) {
      errorEl.textContent = 'Please complete the highlighted fields with valid details.';
      errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      firstBad.focus();
      return;
    }

    const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form).entries());
    delete data.website_hp;

    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = 'Sending...';
    btn.classList.add('opacity-70');

    try {
      if (FORM_ENDPOINT) {
        // Apps Script web apps don't answer CORS preflight, so send a "simple" request:
        // no custom headers, no-cors mode, JSON as plain text. The response is opaque,
        // so success = the request didn't throw.
        await fetch(FORM_ENDPOINT, {
          method: 'POST',
          mode: 'no-cors',
          body: JSON.stringify(data)
        });
      } else {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));
      }
      document.getElementById('successName').textContent = data.name.split(' ')[0];
      form.classList.add('hidden');
      successBox.classList.remove('hidden');
      successBox.focus();
      // Optional: fire your Pixel event here, e.g. fbq('track', 'Lead');
    } catch (err) {
      errorEl.textContent = 'Something went wrong sending your application. Please try again or message me on WhatsApp.';
      errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = 'Submit Application';
      btn.classList.remove('opacity-70');
    }
  });

  form.addEventListener('input', (e) => e.target.classList.remove('invalid'));

  // Proof gallery lightbox
  const lightbox = document.getElementById('lightbox');
  const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightboxImg');
  const lightboxCap = document.getElementById('lightboxCap');
  document.querySelectorAll('.proof').forEach((b) => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      lightboxImg.src = b.querySelector('img').src;
      lightboxImg.alt = b.dataset.cap;
      lightboxCap.textContent = b.dataset.cap;
      lightbox.showModal();
    });
  });
  // Click on the dark backdrop closes it
  lightbox.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === lightbox) lightbox.close(); });
</script>
</body>
</html>
